Pay special attention to:
- AC1: ownership scoping by userId/PAID/ACTIVE.
- AC2: 401 unauthenticated, NextResponse.json usage, no client-side auth assumption.
- AC3: checkout success and /progress both go to `/day/{currentDay}` not hardcoded `/day/1`.
- AC4: missing program with profile actually creates program + 14 days; missing program without profile returns recoverable state, not pretend success.
- AC5: scope boundary — the new pages do NOT pre-implement Day UI (no exercise cards, no completion CTA, no analytics).
- AC6: invalid day, future day, missing content all hit safe branches and not uncaught errors.
- AC7: session shape unchanged — confirm by checking `src/lib/auth/options.ts` and ensuring no session mutations in this story.
- AC8: tests cover unauth 401/redirects, currentDay > 1, missing-program recovery, no-purchase fallback, invalid/future day, checkout-success currentDay link, with no regression.

Return only the per-AC verdict line block + the concerns list. No other prose.
